video.title: AI欧腐《S级Alpha掌握了我的秘密/The S-Rank Alpha Owns My Secret》
video.desc:
橄榄球狼人版
Omega Elio Collins disguises himself as a Beta to chase his dream of becoming a director. But S-Rank Alpha football star Karl Blackwood discovers his secret. A forced bargain turns into jealousy, protection, and love—until a betrayal threatens Elio’s future and reveals Karl is his fated soulmate.
Omega Elio Collins为了追逐导演梦，伪装成Beta进入大学。然而S级Alpha、橄榄球明星Karl Blackwood发现了他的秘密。一场被迫的交易，逐渐演变成嫉妒、守护与爱情。直到一次背叛危及Elio的未来，也揭开了真相：Karl正是他的命定伴侣。
